what: the flange top annulus of a freshly revolved hub (z = 6, r 18..30) picked by a point and extruded 5 mm (the pick found a third of the face: "the selected planar face no longer exists")
method: hub = revolve of (8,0) (30,0) (30,6) (18,6) (18,22) (8,22) about Z: V = pi [(30^2 - 8^2) 6 + (18^2 - 8^2) 16] = 28826.6. Extruding the whole annulus z = 6, r 18..30 outward (upward) 5 mm adds pi (30^2 - 18^2) 5 = 9047.8 (the new ring sits on the flange and touches the hub wall r = 18).
